lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Fixed the reviewer-flagged mischaracterization of ADR-0045 in docs/adr/0049-garboard-naming-policy-binary-alias-org-and-staged-rename.md. The finding: ADR 0049's line 17 claimed it 'supersedes only the naming-deferral clause of ADR-0045', but ADR-0045's Decision section never deferred the command name, it *decided* it ('Deliberately leave the cam command, config/state directories, CAM_* env vars ... unchanged'); ADR-0045's only actual deferral clause was 'Defer the GitHub repo / local directory rename to a separate operator-driven step with a coordinated fixture sweep', which ADR 0049 never mentioned. Root-cause fix (three edits, all in docs/adr/0049-...md): (1) Context paragraph (was line 5): rewrote to state ADR-0045 decided, not deferred, the command-name clause, and correctly identify the GitHub repo/local directory rename as ADR-0045's only real deferral. (2) Decision section opener (was line 17): rewrote to say this ADR supersedes the *command-name clause* of ADR-0045's Decision as of the launch-packaging stage of the staged rename plan (install compatibility preserved via the legacy `cam` symlink), explicitly disclaims superseding a 'naming-deferral clause' since none existed for the command name, and states ADR-0045's one real deferral clause (GitHub repo/local directory rename) is untouched by this ADR and remains open (neither decided nor executed by this docs-only cycle). (3) Consequences section (was line 34, 'surprising without context' framing): reworded 'deferred the name' to 'decided to keep the cam command unchanged' for internal consistency with the corrected Context/Decision framing, so the doc doesn't repeat the same mischaracterization in a third spot. Swept full file for em-dash/emoji regressions post-edit (clean, zero matches). No tests reference this ADR's prose, so no test changes were needed. Full check:all spine ran green (typecheck ok, tests 5585 pass/0 fail, lint ok with 1 pre-existing biome.json deprecation info-only notice unrelated to this story, file-size ok, debt-markers ok, version-skips ok, coverage ok, dead-code ok with pre-existing knip config hints unrelated to this story, dup ok, ci-parity ok, agents-md ok, test-sleeps ok); no file-size/coverage ceiling raise needed, this is a same-file text substitution with a net +3/-3 line delta.
